SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. ______
H. Q. Crime Branch Station,
Date December 2nd 1930

Subject (in full) Re attached

Made By ______ and ______ Forwarded by C.D.I. Hunter

Sir,
With reference to attached. In 1929 C.D.C. 17 Tien
Tsen Woo (卞增華) introduced female Mo Tsan Ying (馬彩英) as
agent to the Head quarters staff. She was duly engaged and
her husband Hsu Yong Liang (not proper husband and wife,
different names) became jealous of C.D.C. 17 Tien Tsen Woo
sweethearting with his supposed wife, which is probably true.
Mo Tsan Ying, during her period of employment with the Head-
quarters Staff in 1929 became pregnant and had to leave the
Police Service.

I understand that at 9 p.m. on 1-12-30 the lady in question
Mo Tsan Ying reported at Louza Station that she was afraid of
her husband Hsu Yong Liang (許鴻良) and was seeking the pro-
tection of the Door of Hope. She was accordingly detained for
the night being sent to the Door of Hope, and appeared before
the Shanghai Special District Court on the 2-12-30 when she
was handed over to her sister Lieu Mo Sz (刘馬氏) and a
summons issued for the appearance of her husband. She alleges
that her husband is an armed robber and has already been con-
victed by the Chinese Authorities for robbery committed at
Tang Doc (唐渡) C.C.L.

In view of the statements and reports attached, I re-
commend that C.D.C. 17 Tien Tsen Woo be either reverted to
uniform or dismissed as he is not suitable for the Crime
Branch if mixed up in this sort of affair.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
Hunter
C.D.I.

(husband).

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号 ______
总部刑事股分局，
日期 1930年12月2日

主题（全称）关于附件

由 ______ 和 ______ 制作 由 C.D.I. Hunter 转呈

先生，
关于附件。1929年，华籍侦探主任（C.D.C.）17号 卞增華（Tien Tsen Woo）将女子 馬彩英（Mo Tsan Ying）作为线人介绍给总部职员。她随即受聘，其丈夫 許鴻良（Hsu Yong Liang，并非正式夫妻，姓氏不同）因嫉妒 C.D.C. 17号 卞增華 与其所谓的妻子亲热，这很可能是事实。馬彩英 在1929年受雇于总部职员期间怀孕，不得不离开警队服务。

据悉，1930年12月1日晚9时，上述女子 馬彩英 向老闸捕房报案，称害怕其丈夫 許鴻良，并寻求救世军门（Door of Hope）的庇护。因此她被拘留过夜并被送往救世军门，随后于1930年12月2日出庭上海特区地方法院，当时她被移交给其姐姐 刘馬氏（Lieu Mo Sz），并向其丈夫发出传票。她指控其丈夫是一名持械劫匪，且已因在 唐渡（Tang Doc） 实施的抢劫案被中国当局定罪。

鉴于所附陈述和报告，我建议将 C.D.C. 17号 卞增華 要么恢复制服职务，要么予以开除，因为他若卷入此类事务，便不适合在刑事股工作。

此致，
敬礼，
Hunter
华籍侦探主任（C.D.I.）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ______

REPORT
H.Q. Crime Branch Station,
Date December 2, 1930.

Subject (in full) Alleged attempt to abduct S.D.J. 17 Bien Tsen Woo by 3 Chinese soldiers.

Made by A.D. Ovsianikoff Forwarded by J.M.E. Hunter

Sir,

At 5 p.m. on December 1, 1930, S.D.J. 17 Bien Tsen Woo attached to Headquarters Crime Branch brought to the Central Station a Chinese Lieutenant Quartermaster of 1st Brigade stationed at Haichow named Fong Tong Yuan (方敦源), Chinese officer attached to the same brigade named Lee S Yuen (李世元), Chinese soldier named Van Tun Sung (范得勝), a Chinese male named Hsu Vong Liang (許鴻良) and a female Lieu Mo Sz (劉馬氏), and reported that the said male persons attempted to take him by force to Lunghwa Military Headquarters. In view of the fact that the said detective is attached to Headquarters Crime Branch the case was referred to this office. From inquiries made it appears that at about 8.00 p.m. while S.D.J. 17 was walking along Kiangse Road near Nanking Road, he was approached by his relative, a female named Lieu Mo Sz, who asked him to go to her house at Ming Tsong Lee alleyway, off Szechuen Road. He went to this house as requested and stayed there for sometime. While he was in the house a Chinese named Hsu Vong Liang, brother-in-law of the female Lieu Mo Sz and formerly residing in her house, entered together with a Chinese officer and a soldier. Hsu Vong Liang, whose wife named Ho Tsun Ying (何春英) formerly attached to Headquarters Staff, has absconded about 3 days ago and he suspected that his wife's sister, Lieu Mo Sz and S.D.J. 17 were responsible for her escape and that they know her whereabouts. On seeing the S.D.J. in the house, he asked him regarding whereabouts of his wife and eventually threatened S.D.J. 17 to take him to Military Headquarters if he refuses to say, although they all denied it when questioned by detectives attached to this office. S.D.J. 17 to stop all

(批：Allen Grant / Opium Unit)

总部刑事股分局，
日期 1930年12月2日。

主题（全称）据称三名中国士兵企图绑架 S.D.J. 17号 Bien Tsen Woo。

由 A.D. Ovsianikoff 制作 由 J.M.E. Hunter 转呈

先生，

1930年12月1日下午5时，隶属于总部刑事股的 S.D.J. 17号 Bien Tsen Woo 带了一名驻扎在海州的第一旅中国军需中尉 方敦源（Fong Tong Yuan）、同属该旅的中国军官 李世元（Lee S Yuen）、一名叫 范得勝（Van Tun Sung）的中国士兵、一名叫 許鴻良（Hsu Vong Liang）的中国男子以及一名叫 劉馬氏（Lieu Mo Sz）的女子来到中央巡捕房，并报告称上述男子企图强行将他带往龙华军事司令部。鉴于该侦探隶属于总部刑事股，此案被移交至本办公室。经查询，情况似乎如下：晚上8点左右，S.D.J. 17号 在南京路附近的江西路上行走时，遇到其亲戚、一名叫 劉馬氏 的女子，该女子请他去四川路旁的 明宗里（Ming Tsong Lee alleyway） 她的家中。他按要求去了那所房子并停留了一段时间。当他在屋内时，劉馬氏 的妹夫、曾居住在她家的中国人 許鴻良 与一名中国军官和一名士兵一同进入。許鴻良 的妻子名叫 何春英（Ho Tsun Ying），此前隶属于总部职员，约三天前潜逃，他怀疑妻子的妹妹 劉馬氏 和 S.D.J. 17号 对其逃跑负责，并且知道她的下落。看到屋内的 S.D.J. 后，他询问其妻子的下落，并最终威胁 S.D.J. 17号，如果拒绝说明，就将他带到军事司令部，尽管在本办公室侦探讯问时，他们都予以否认。S.D.J. 17号 停止所有

（批注：Allen Grant / 鸦片组）
（批注：丈夫 Cao / Sin / P.T.）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of C.D.C. 17 Bien Taen Woo
native of ________________________ taken by me Himself
at H.q. C.B. on the 1-12-30 and interpreted by Tau Vi Gi

At about 2 p.m. on 1-12-30 when I was dismissed by D.S. Ovsian-
nikoff at the corner of Kiangse and Nanking Roads corner, I
met my relative Lieu Mo Sz, who asked me to go to her house.
I told her I was on duty, but saying these, we already arrived
at the house. Soon afterwards Hsu Vong Liang accompanied by
three Chinese military officers came and forced us to the house.
One of the officers asked my name and address. I told him and
he wrote them down on a visiting card. He further asked me
where Hsu Vong Liang's wife had absconded to. I told them I
did not know, but all of them pushed me and asked me to follow
them to the Lunghwa Military Headquarters. When we walked
passing Central Police Station, I was going to call Policemen,
when they said they would follow me to the Police Station
on their own accord.

(sgd) Bien Tsen Woo, C.D.C. 17

以下是 C.D.C. 17号 Bien Taen Woo
籍贯 ________________________ 的陈述，由我本人
于1930年12月1日在总部刑事股（H.q. C.B.）录取，由 Tau Vi Gi 翻译

1930年12月1日下午2点左右，当我在江西路和南京路路口被副探长 Ovsian-
nikoff 解散时，我遇到了我的亲戚 劉馬氏，她请我去她家。
我告诉她我在执勤，但说着说着，我们已经到了她家。不久之后，許鴻良 在三名中国军官的陪同下到来，并强迫我们进屋。
其中一名军官询问我的姓名和地址。我告诉了他，
他把它们写在一张名片上。他还问我 許鴻良 的妻子逃到哪里去了。我告诉他们我
不知道，但他们都推搡我，让我跟他们
去龙华军事司令部。当我们走过中央巡捕房时，我正要叫警察，
这时他们说他们会自愿跟我一起去警察局。

（签名）Bien Tsen Woo, C.D.C. 17

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Lien Mo Sz (劉毛司), age 28
native of Shantung taken by me C.D.S. 100 & C.D.C. 13
at H.Q. S.P. on the 1-12-30 and interpreted by Tsaung Yun Tau

I am residing at an upstairs room of a Breakfast Shop, in
Wing Tsong Lee alleyway off Nanking Road. At about 8 p.m. on
1-12-30 I met a Chinese detective Fien Tson Po at the entrance
of Wing Tsong Lee and as we are acquainted with each other, I
asked him to come to my home. He refused because he was very
busy at that time, but as he was talking to me, my brother-in-law
Shu Hsing Hiang, accompanied by three Chinese officers, proceeded
to us and forced us to enter my home. Then one of the officers
asked the name and address of Fien Tson Po and the latter told
him all about it. The officer again said, "Shu Hsing Hiang's
wife had disappeared, do you know where she is? you must accompany
us to the Headquarters at Nanjing." Fien Tson Po refused to go
with them, but the three officers compelled him to leave my
home. I went away with them and as we were passing the Central
Police Station, where Fien intended to call the Police, but
the three officers willingly followed him to the Station.
I also went after them.

( ) Lien Mo Sz

警方调查报告。

以下是 劉毛司（Lien Mo Sz），28岁，
山东籍的陈述，由我 C.D.S. 100号 和 C.D.C. 13号
于1930年12月1日在总部特别股（H.Q. S.P.）录取，由 Tsaung Yun Tau 翻译

我住在南京路旁 永宗里（Wing Tsong Lee alleyway） 一家早餐店的楼上房间。1930年12月1日晚上8点左右，我在 永宗里 门口遇到了一名中国侦探 Fien Tson Po，由于我们彼此认识，我请他来我家。他拒绝了，因为他当时很忙，但当他和我说话时，我的妹夫 Shu Hsing Hiang 在三名中国军官的陪同下向我们走来，并强迫我们进入我家。然后其中一名军官询问 Fien Tson Po 的姓名和地址，后者如实告知。该军官又说：“Shu Hsing Hiang 的妻子失踪了，你知道她在哪里吗？你必须陪我们去南京的司令部。” Fien Tson Po 拒绝跟他们走，但这三名军官强迫他离开我家。我和他们一起走了，当我们经过中央巡捕房时，Fien 打算叫警察，但这三名军官自愿跟随他去了警局。
我也跟在他们后面去了。

( ) Lien Mo Sz

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Hsu Vong Liang (許榮良), age 42
native of Anhwei taken by me C.D.S. 31
at H.Q. C.B. on the 1-12-30 and interpreted by Tsu Vi Gi

S 47 E
My wife Mo Tsan Ying had been a female agent attached to Head-quarters Staff from June to November 1929. After her resignation she had been living at her sister's house in Ming Tsong Lee alleyway, off Kiangse Road. I had attempted for several times to bring my wife back to my home in Kompo, but her sister always refused to let her go.

At about 12 noon 1-11-30 I went to Room No. 202 Central Hotel to visit my friend named Fong Tong Yuen. At about 3.30 p.m. I went with him to my sister-in-law's home on Kiangse Rd. A bodyguard accompanied him. On Foochow Road we met Fong Tong Yuen's fellow officer named Lee S Yuen, who was invited to go with us. When we entered the house and proceeded to the up-stairs room, a detective named Bien was already there. I introduced him to my friends. Unexpectedly Mr. Bien asked us the purpose of our coming there. I told him that I thought there would no objection in coming to my relative's house. Mr. Bien then asked us to go with him to Police Station..

My wife Mo Tsan Ying had been evading me for three days.

(sgd) Hsu Vong Liang.

（左侧手写批注：There is a General order that...）

以下是 許榮良（Hsu Vong Liang），42岁，
安徽籍的陈述，由我 C.D.S. 31号
于1930年12月1日在总部刑事股（H.Q. C.B.）录取，由 Tsu Vi Gi 翻译

S 47 E
我的妻子 馬彩英（Mo Tsan Ying）从1929年6月至11月一直是隶属于总部职员的女线人。辞职后，她一直住在江西路旁 明宗里 她姐姐的家里。我曾多次试图把我的妻子带回我在虹口（Kompo）的家，但她的姐姐总是拒绝让她走。

1930年11月1日中午12点左右，我去中央饭店202室拜访我的朋友 方敦源（Fong Tong Yuen）。下午3点30分左右，我和他一起去了我在江西路的妻姐家。一名保镖陪同他。在福州路上，我们遇到了 方敦源 的同僚军官 李世元（Lee S Yuen），并邀请他同行。当我们进屋并走上楼上的房间时，一名叫 Bien 的侦探已经在那里。我把他介绍给我的朋友们。出乎意料的是，Bien 先生询问我们来此的目的。我告诉他，我想去亲戚家应该没有异议。随后 Bien 先生要求我们跟他去警察局..

我的妻子 馬彩英 已经躲了我三天。

（签名）Hsu Vong Liang.

（左侧手写批注：有一项一般命令规定...）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Fong Tong Yuen (方敦源), age 23
native of Anhwei taken by me C.D.C. 85
at H.Q. C.B. on the 1-12-30 and interpreted by Tsu Vi Hi

I am a Quartermaster attached to 1st Brigade, Haichow.
I accompanied my Brigade General Fong Zung Sen to Shanghai on
26-11-30. I am living in Room No. 23 Fah Yang Hotel, Boundary
Road, whilst Brigade General Fong living in Room No. 202 Cen-
tral Hotel, Hupeh Road. At about 3 p.m. 1-12-30 I was in Room
No. 23 Central Hotel, where my friend named Hsu Voong Liang
offered to lead me to have a sight-seeing. On Foochow Road
we met Lee S Yuen , an officer of the 1st Brigade. Mr. Hsu
then asked us to go with him to the house where he was living.
in an alleyway
When we entered the house/off Kiangse Road we saw a male and
a female there. The male Chinese asked me my name, and I told
him. On being asked, he told me that his name is Bien Tsen Woo,
a Settlement detective. He asked us why we came to the house
and wanted us to leave our names in the Police Station. We
refused to do so, but he said he would call Policeman if we did
not. So we followed him to the Police Station.

(sgd) Fong Tong Yuen

以下是 方敦源（Fong Tong Yuen），23岁，
安徽籍的陈述，由我 C.D.C. 85号
于1930年12月1日在总部刑事股（H.Q. C.B.）录取，由 Tsu Vi Hi 翻译

我是驻扎在海州的第一旅的军需官。
1930年11月26日，我陪同我的旅长 方 Zun Sen 将军来到上海。
我住在边界路法阳旅馆23号房间，而方旅长住在湖北路中央饭店202号房间。1930年12月1日下午3点左右，我在中央饭店23号房间，我的朋友 許 Voong Liang 提出带我去观光。在福州路上，我们遇到了第一旅的军官 李世元（Lee S Yuen）。許 先生随后请我们跟他去他住的房子。
在一条巷子里
当我们进入江西路旁的房子/时，我们看到里面有一男一女。那名中国男子询问我的姓名，我告诉了他。在被问及身份时，他告诉我他叫 Bien Tsen Woo，是一名租界侦探。他问我们为什么来这所房子，并要求我们在警察局留下姓名。我们拒绝这样做，但他说如果我们不照办，他就会叫警察。所以我们跟着他去了警察局。

（签名）Fong Tong Yuen

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Lee S. Yuen (李世元) age 34
native of Shanghai taken by me C.D.C. 13 Tseng Hsin Ang
at H.Q. C.P. on the 1-12-50 and interpreted by □□□ □□□ □□□

I am an officer attached to the 1st Brigade, Military
Police, Shanghai on 29-11-50 and resided at Room No. 85, Dai-
dong Hotel, Temple Road. At about 7 p.m. on 1-12-50 quarter-
past seven Chung Huan, I met Mr. Luh Tung and I loitered on
the street and met one country friend Chu Hoong Liang, who invited
us to his home. There I saw Mr. Tsoo Sing asking one C.D.C. 17
Chin Chen if he had found the whereabout of Chu's wife. Then
Chu blamed us why we three came there. I explained that we came
to visit Chu Hoong Liang. Tsoo continued saying that we three
must go to the Police Station with him, so he accompanied us
to the Central Station.

(Sd.) Lee S. Yuen.

以下为李世元（Lee S. Yuen），34岁，上海籍，于1950年12月1日在中央捕房总部由我，刑事侦缉处警探第13号曾新昂（Tseng Hsin Ang）录取，并由□□□ □□□ □□□翻译的供词：

我隶属于上海宪兵第一旅，1950年11月29日时居住在庙路（Temple Road）大东旅馆85号房间。1950年12月1日晚上7点15分左右，我在中环遇到陆通（Luh Tung）先生，我们在街上闲逛时遇到了一位乡下朋友朱洪良（Chu Hoong Liang），他邀请我们去他家。在那里，我看到邹星（Tsoo Sing）先生询问刑事侦缉处警探第17号陈珍（Chin Chen）是否找到了朱某妻子的下落。随后，朱某责备我们三人为何去那里。我解释说我们是去拜访朱洪良的。邹星接着说我们三人必须跟他去警察局，于是他便陪同我们去了中央捕房。

（签名）李世元。

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Van Tuh Sung (范得勝), age 33
native of Anhwei taken by me C.2.00 134
at H.Q. C.I.D. on the 1-12-30 and interpreted by Tsu Yi Gi

I am a soldier attached to the 1st Brigade, Haichow. I came
to Shanghai from Haichow with my Quartermaster named Fong Tong
Yuen (方同元) and lived at Room No. 202 Central Hotel, Nanch
Road.

At about 3 p.m. on 1-12-30 a friend of Lieutenant Fong's
came and asked him to go out with him to have a sight-seeing.
He first led us to the house where he was living (the place
unknown to me). When we entered the house, we met a man
with whom Lieutenant Fong came to have a conversation, the
subject of which I did not notice. The man, whose name I
later learned was Rich, asked me to go together with them
to Police Station. I do not know what is the trouble.

(sgd) Van Tuh Sung

以下为范得勝（Van Tuh Sung），33岁，安徽籍，于1930年12月1日在刑事侦缉处总部由我，刑事侦缉处警探第134号录取，并由朱义吉（Tsu Yi Gi）翻译的供词：

我是海州第一旅的一名士兵。我与我的军需官方同元（Fong Tong Yuen）一起从海州来到上海，居住在南京路中央旅馆202号房间。

1930年12月1日下午3点左右，方副官的一位朋友来找他，请他一同外出观光。他先带我们去了他居住的房子（该地点我不清楚）。当我们进入屋内时，遇到了一名男子，方副官与他进行了交谈，我没注意谈话内容。这名男子，我后来得知其名为里奇（Rich），要求我随他们一起去警察局。我不知道出了什么事。

（签名）范得勝

The following is the statement of Hsu Mo Sz (许马氏) alias Mo Tsan Ying (马彩美)
native of Shantung taken by me Tsu Yi Gi
at H.Q. C.I.D. on the 2-11-30 and interpreted by Tsu Yi Gi

I am a native of Shantung, age 35. I was married to Hsu
Vong Liang in May 1922 at Wong Doo, where we lived for about
four years, and during which period my husband made his living
by smuggling salt. In the autumn of 1927 my husband was
put into jail on a charge of armed robbery committed by him
at a cotton shop in Tsung Ka Zah village, Wong Doo. As I
had no means of living, I went to Shanghai and lived in my
sister Hsu Mo Sz's house in Ming Tsong Lee alleyway, off
Kiangsi Road. In July 1929 I was introduced by my brother-
in-law Tien Tsen Woo (J.L.J. 17) to be a female agent attached
with my husband's consent.
to the Headquarters Staff/ In December I was dismissed by
Mr. Aiers on account of my physical unfitness. Ever since
I had been living at my sister's house, but my husband, who
was then in Yangchow, never visited me nor sent me any living
expenses. In June 1930 I went to Yangchow to find my husband
and discovered that he was living with another woman. I argued
with him but he assaulted me in every way. Finding that I
could not get out a way with him I left him and went back to
Shanghai. On November 24, 1930, my husband came to Shang-
hai from Yangchow and met me at my sister's house. He accused
me that I ran away from him and wished to take me back to
Yangchow. As he had forsaken me and lived with another wo-
man, I went to apply myself at the "Door of Hope", Nanking
Road, at about 12 m.n. on November 28, 1930. It was late
then, and the door was closed, so I went temporarily to my cou-
sin Vung Yoong Hwo's house at No. 107 Sing Kong Lee off Tatung
Road. I made a second attempt at the "Door of Hope" at about

以下为许马氏（Hsu Mo Sz），别名马彩美（Mo Tsan Ying），山东籍，于1930年11月2日在刑事侦缉处总部由我，朱义吉（Tsu Yi Gi）录取，并由朱义吉翻译的供词：

我是山东人，35岁。1922年5月，我在王杜（Wong Doo）与许旺良（Hsu Vong Liang）结婚，我们在那里住了大约四年，期间我丈夫靠走私盐为生。1927年秋，我丈夫因在王杜宗家扎村（Tsung Ka Zah village）的一家棉花店实施持械抢劫而被捕入狱。由于我没有生活来源，便前往上海，住在江西路旁明宗里（Ming Tsong Lee alleyway）我姐姐许马氏的家中。1929年7月，经我姐夫田振武（Tien Tsen Woo，J.L.J. 17）介绍，并在我丈夫同意下，我成为总部职员中的一名女特工。12月，艾尔斯（Aiers）先生以我身体不适合为由将我解雇。此后我一直住在姐姐家，但我丈夫当时在扬州，从未探望过我，也未寄给我任何生活费。1930年6月，我去扬州寻找丈夫，发现他与另一名女子同居。我与他争吵，但他对我百般殴打。见无法与他相处，我便离开他回到上海。1930年11月24日，我丈夫从扬州来到上海，在我姐姐家与我见面。他指责我离家出走，并想带我回扬州。鉴于他抛弃了我并与另一女子同居，我于1930年11月28日午夜12点左右前往南京路的“希望之门”（Door of Hope）申请收容。当时天色已晚，大门紧闭，所以我暂时去了大同路辛公里（Sing Kong Lee）107号我表亲翁永火（Vung Yoong Hwo）的家中。第二天凌晨4点左右，我再次尝试进入“希望之门”，但被拒绝。早上7点，我试图进入河南路桥的“救世军”（Chiu Tsi Wei），但再次被拒。随后我前往南市小南门的上海妇女协会，但他们也不接收我。见申请未果，我便前往老闸捕房，希望他们能介绍我进入“希望之门”。当被问及申请加入该协会的原因时，我说，与其做许旺良的妻子——他品行恶劣且抛弃了我——我宁愿在协会中度过余生。

    4 a.m. next morning, but was refused. At 7 a.m. I attempted
at "Chiu Tsi Wei", Honan Road Bridge, but was again refused.
Later I proceeded to Shanghai Woman's Society at Small South
Gate, Nantao, but they did not accept me. Seeing that
I was not successful in my attempts, I went to Louza Station
hoping that they would introduce me to the "Door of Hope".
When questioned as to my reason for applying myself to be
admitted to the Society, I stated that I would rather pass
my life in the Society than to be the wife of Hsu Vong Liang
who is a bad character and had forsaken me.

                                        (sgd) Hsu Mo Sz
